text: Tart with a smile! Greet politely: ‘Hello, my name is…’Speak clearly and not too fast. Confidence shows that you believe in your idea.
What you want (e.g., people to try it, or support it)
Show enthusiasm! If you’re excited about your idea, others will be too.
See the person when you speak as it shows confidence and respect.
Stand tall, don’t slouch. Use small, natural hand gestures. Avoid fidgeting.
Practice your pitch, but make it sound like you’re telling a story to a friend.
Say “Thank you for listening!” You can add: “Would you like to know more?” or “Can I show you how it works?”
Rehearse your pitch with a parent, a teacher, or a friend. The more you practice, the more confident you’ll become!
